metadata.agent_last_message:
Created the C++20 project in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt) and [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp). It builds successfully with `cmake -B build output && cmake --build build`.

The implementation is incomplete relative to the requested contract: parsing only extracts basic Directory Entry information, canonical JSON output is largely unpopulated, and `write`, `roundtrip`, and evaluation are not implemented. It does not yet support lossless round-tripping or the 87-entity catalog.
